summary: Videos edited or produced for the school's student channel: two IASAS sendoff hype videos and the first two episodes of BTV IASAS Hot Ones.

body.heading: The sendoffs
body.text: Hype videos for the teams heading to IASAS. The job: make athletes look intimidating in under three minutes.

body.heading: Hot Ones
body.text: A school-sized version of the interview show where the questions get harder as the sauce gets hotter. The job: make hot sauce look worse.
